title: Livery in production
slide_intent: Inspect production at full scale because material application can reveal problems absent from a mockup.
strategic_value: A real fuselage test can help Lufthansa check lettering against windows, seams and masking.
demonstration: A partially masked aircraft fuselage carries a small Boeing 747–8 Brandenburg label near the windows.
practical_value: Check physical registration and surface constraints before approving final markings.

content_islands.name: Production surface
content_islands.spec: Frame the fuselage, windows, label and masking material together.
